notes.title: Oculus Rift support!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31387760/7fff53cf6208ebe70f08478bac2ae98c113649f4.jpg[/img]
[b]Hello Graviators![/b]

Now you can race also with your [b]Oculus Rift[/b] headset! Moreover opponents are much more balanced.

We want you to know what is going on with the game so our plan for game development in upcoming months is now in description of the game, check it out!

Also we're launching [b]40%[/b] discount for the game!

Let us know what else we can improve.

notes.title: Galaxy Race Demo Update is live & full gamekey giveaway!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31387760/4c2fee082e831f1326f8d8473cbc34d33cd8396f.jpg[/img]

We have just released an update for Galaxy Race Demo, as we mentioned in previous news. Brand new racetrack with time-trial mode has been added and some minor bugs has been fixed.

We would also like to encourage you to give us some feedback: how do you like our game and what can we improve to make it even cooler! 
We'll choose one of your comments and give the author a key for the full game when it gets released (VERY SOON!!!). 

Be ready for THE GAME Gravitators!
